intent: change stable stats or fields
add deterministic records

conditions: No runtime/load-order discovery is required.

preemptive_questions: Does this need an ESL/light plugin?

runtime_tests: Load plugin and inspect affected forms.
negative_tests: Verify unrelated override fields remain unchanged.

patterns.notes: Prefer typed field edits over whole-record copying.

intent: merge or reconcile many installed mods
patch final load order

conditions: Result depends on the user's active load order.

preemptive_questions: Which fields merge vs choose one source?

runtime_tests: Query final winner for representative records.

patterns.notes: Generated output is never canonical source.

intent: give actors spells perks items outfits factions keywords

conditions: Targets are expressible through SPID filters and supported distribution types.

runtime_tests: Positive and negative actor recipients; duplicate prevention.
negative_tests: Actor failing filter must not receive distribution.

patterns.notes: Runtime distribution usually reduces NPC_ conflicts.

intent: classify records with keywords
add or remove semantic keywords

conditions: Target form types and filters are supported by KID.

preemptive_questions: Is keyword UI-only or gameplay semantic?
Can another framework generate same keyword?

runtime_tests: Query representative forms after KID applies.

patterns.notes: Document runtime-added keywords because xEdit cannot show them.

intent: replace placed object bases conditionally
seasonal or contextual object swaps

conditions: Swap preserves compatible reference semantics.

preemptive_questions: Does new base have compatible type/collision/scripts?

human_checks: Visual placement check when geometry differs.

patterns.notes: BOS changes base object, not reference position/save identity.

intent: add or remove forms from FormLists

avoid_by_default: script loops mutating lists every load
conditions: Order/pairing semantics are understood.

runtime_tests: Inspect final list and count after load.
negative_tests: No duplicates; paired-list invariants stay aligned.

patterns.notes: Index-paired FormLists require cross-list validation.

intent: runtime patch supported record fields without plugin conflicts

conditions: SkyPatcher supports the exact record/property semantics.

preemptive_questions: What wins if several configs touch same field?

runtime_tests: Static winner vs post-patch runtime state.

patterns.notes: Always preserve a static→runtime provenance chain.

intent: replace animations by actor state equipment keywords conditions

conditions: Existing graph semantics are sufficient; only clip selection changes.

patterns.notes: Use behavior tooling only if state machine semantics must change.

intent: add animation graph state transition event or behavior semantics

conditions: A graph-level change is genuinely required.

runtime_tests: Trigger each new transition and recover.
negative_tests: Unknown event/state does not deadlock graph.

patterns.notes: Generated behavior output should be rebuilt, not hand-edited.

intent: event-driven quest gameplay state
moderate-frequency scripted mechanics

avoid_by_default: frame polling when an event exists
conditions: Engine/Papyrus exposes needed events and latency is acceptable.

runtime_tests: new game save/load upgrade; feature-specific events.
negative_tests: dependency absent; None references; repeated event.

patterns.notes: Generate a Lilac/runtime test for pure logic where possible. Use Pyro to own repeatable multi-script/project builds; search Papyrus Extender APIs/events before escalating to a custom native DLL.

intent: engine hook
per-frame high-volume feature
custom serialization
deep render input physics access

conditions: Papyrus/data/runtime patchers cannot safely meet requirements.

runtime_tests: startup new-game load save revert dependency-absent runtime matrix.
negative_tests: Unsupported runtime/API provider must fail closed.

patterns.notes: Prefer engine event/API over machine-code hook when possible. Before writing a new hook/API, search Papyrus Extender and existing SKSE/CommonLib event/API surfaces; compile every declared runtime target through the native build adapters.

intent: add persistent user settings
expose native/Papyrus configuration

conditions: SkyUI/MCM is acceptable dependency and values map cleanly to settings.

runtime_tests: change setting restart/load and verify behavior.

patterns.notes: Keep one canonical setting store.

intent: native developer/config UI
rich C++ diagnostics

conditions: Native plugin already exists and UI is primarily settings/debugging.

runtime_tests: open close input focus settings persistence.
negative_tests: Typing must not trigger gameplay hotkeys.

patterns.notes: Do not make UI framework the settings source of truth.

intent: rich HTML CSS JS in-game interface

conditions: Feature materially benefits from web-layout UI.

patterns.notes: Native backend validates all UI commands.

intent: create or modify Skyrim mesh
rigging partitions collision shader

conditions: Geometry work is required.

patterns.notes: AI 3D is source geometry only until Skyrim-specific validation passes.

intent: armor outfit conversion
BodySlide sliders
body morph distribution

avoid_by_default: editing generated BodySlide output as source
conditions: Body/outfit topology and target body family are known.

patterns.notes: Generated meshes are downstream of BodySlide project source.

intent: choose or synthesize NPC face replacers
resolve dark-face issues

avoid_by_default: mixing face fields from several sources
conditions: Goal is appearance selection/merge.

patterns.notes: One coherent visual source per NPC unless deliberately regenerated.

intent: quest stages aliases dialogue scenes packages

avoid_by_default: blind raw binary generation for complex editor bookkeeping
conditions: Editor-owned relationships or visual graph authoring are material.

runtime_tests: start conditions aliases every stage scene save/load.
negative_tests: Invalid alias fill and condition paths.

patterns.notes: Generate static data where safe, but post-validate CK bookkeeping.

intent: generate voiced dialogue
batch AI voice lines

conditions: Dialogue text and voice identity are final enough to generate.

runtime_tests: play representative lines and lip sync.

patterns.notes: Generate voice after IDs stabilize or regenerate on identity changes.

intent: place objects edit cells interiors exteriors landscape

conditions: Spatial authoring is required.

negative_tests: No stale missing refs or unintended cell-field reverts.

patterns.notes: CK is the spatial authoring authority; xEdit is post-save validator.

intent: change walkable geometry or pathing

conditions: World geometry changes require AI traversal update.

runtime_tests: NPC traverses paths doors combat follow.

patterns.notes: Keep navmesh mutation supervised until a validated typed CK worker exists.

intent: generate terrain object tree grass distant LOD

conditions: World/assets changed in a way affecting distant representation.

negative_tests: Input hash/load-order change marks output stale.

patterns.notes: Hash generator inputs and rebuild downstream only.

intent: freeform NPC conversation memory actions LLM behavior

conditions: Freeform model-driven behavior is explicitly part of the mod design.

runtime_tests: conversation memory action eligibility offline/provider failure.
negative_tests: Model must not execute unapproved consequential action.

patterns.notes: Use deterministic vanilla quest/dialogue if freeform AI is not a requirement.

intent: automate live game testing
drive repeatable scenario

conditions: A running-game state can be queried/controlled safely on a fixture.

negative_tests: Health stall/missing event/transport success without state change.

patterns.notes: Prefer event waits and read-act-read over sleeps.

intent: update persistent mod state across versions

conditions: Released version already persists state.

runtime_tests: upgrade from every supported prior schema; save/load/revert.

patterns.notes: Migration code, not cleanup tools, is the primary solution.

intent: build installer and release package

conditions: Project has options/dependencies needing installer.

negative_tests: Every option path must resolve files/dependencies.

patterns.notes: Public release adds rights/provenance gate beyond private packaging.

intent: diagnose CTD freeze native crash

conditions: Failure is runtime crash/freeze.

negative_tests: Disable suspected layer one at a time.

patterns.notes: First causal evidence outranks frequency folklore.

intent: change perks combat formulas weapon damage stamina blocking stagger or attack rules
rebalance combat mechanics without unnecessary scripts

conditions: Use PERK Entry Points/MGEF/CSTY/GMST/data records when engine semantics already exist.
Use Synthesis when final behavior depends on other installed perk/combat overhauls.

preemptive_questions: Which existing overhaul is authoritative for overlapping perk/weapon/combat fields?

negative_tests: actor without perk must retain baseline
unrelated perk Entry Points remain unchanged

patterns.notes: Prefer engine-native Entry Points/data before scripting arithmetic.

intent: create or rebalance spells magic effects enchantments shouts or magic schools

avoid_by_default: scripted recreation of an existing MagicEffect archetype
conditions: Use native MGEF archetypes when possible.
Add Papyrus only for behavior the archetype/effect-item model cannot express.

preemptive_questions: What are casting type delivery magnitude duration area and resistance semantics?
Should effects stack, refresh, peak-value-winner, or be mutually exclusive?
patterns.notes: Trace SPEL EffectItem and MGEF separately.

intent: add or change smithing tempering alchemy cooking crafting recipes and categories

avoid_by_default: editing output item just to alter recipe
conditions: COBJ conditions/components/workbench keyword are usually the primary surface.
Use COCKS/KID only for extensible presentation/classification needs.

preemptive_questions: Should other crafting overhauls' recipe conditions be retained?
patterns.notes: Patch COBJ semantics independently from output item stats.

intent: change barter vendor inventories gold services crime values or economy progression

conditions: Use leveled/vendor lists and factions for stable economy rules.
Use CID/CDF/runtime distribution when compatibility with many merchants is better than base-container overrides.

preemptive_questions: Are prices altered through GMST/perks or item base values?
patterns.notes: Separate vendor stock from barter formula.

intent: create follower companion behavior schedules sandbox combat follow wait dismiss or home systems

avoid_by_default: hard-coded follower reference when an alias can own identity
conditions: Use quest aliases/packages/dialogue for durable follower architecture.
Use events/package evaluation rather than continuous polling.

preemptive_questions: Existing follower frameworks to integrate with?
patterns.notes: Alias ownership and package priority should be explicit.

intent: change NPC daily routines packages sandbox schedules crime reactions or behavior

avoid_by_default: global script polling to force schedules
conditions: Use PACK/package lists/conditions for ordinary schedules.
Preserve quest alias package overrides and location/navmesh feasibility.

preemptive_questions: How should quests/combat/emergencies override the schedule?

runtime_tests: observe package at each schedule transition

patterns.notes: AI package correctness requires both eligibility and reachable world geometry.

intent: add hunger fatigue cold exposure wetness camping or time-based needs

conditions: Drive slow needs from elapsed game time/events.
Choose explicit ownership for hunger fatigue cold and travel restrictions to avoid double systems.

patterns.notes: Prefer event/time-delta updates over high-frequency loops.

intent: add new skill tree perk points XP progression or custom leveling

avoid_by_default: pretending a new engine ActorValue can be created
conditions: Use Custom Skills Framework or explicit custom state rather than extending the fixed ActorValue enum.
Separate UI/progression from actual perk gameplay effects.

patterns.notes: Stable skill IDs are save/API contracts.

intent: add items to chests corpses vendors or placed containers without static conflicts

conditions: Choose CID/CDF according to target/reference/filter semantics.
Document respawn/reapplication behavior.

patterns.notes: xEdit may show no corresponding inventory override.

intent: add inventory icons descriptions categories crafting categories or dynamic item status

avoid_by_default: replacing core SkyUI SWFs for metadata-only needs
conditions: Prefer metadata injectors to broad SWF replacement.
Test each target menu because data exposure differs by menu.

preemptive_questions: Which menus must display the information?
Static semantic icon or dynamic instance/status icon?
patterns.notes: Menu-specific data availability must be tested.

intent: change exterior weather climate fog imagespace volumetric or interior lighting

avoid_by_default: whole CELL forwarding from one lighting mod
conditions: Separate weather selection (CLMT/REGN) from appearance (WTHR).
Separate interior CELL/LGTM/IMGS from exterior weather and renderer effects.

patterns.notes: Record exact time/weather/renderer when comparing visuals.

intent: change water appearance flow types heights sounds or distant water

avoid_by_default: blindly restoring vanilla CELL water fields
conditions: Patch water fields independently from unrelated CELL edits.
Preserve intended SE flow data and WRLD distant-water data.

preemptive_questions: Which water overhaul is truth source?
patterns.notes: A seam following a cell boundary is a data clue, not automatically a texture issue.

intent: add or replace music ambient sounds reverb acoustics or contextual audio

avoid_by_default: one giant MUSC/CELL patch when runtime distribution can merge safely
conditions: Use MTD for runtime music list/location/region assignment where appropriate.
Use SRD for supported sound field distribution.

negative_tests: cell lighting mod overwrites acoustic space

patterns.notes: Track selection and resource playback are separate layers.

intent: add custom map compass markers icons discovery rules or marker framework support

avoid_by_default: custom core-map SWF replacement for icon-only support
conditions: Use CoMAP configuration/resource model when compatible.
Keep marker icon semantics separate from fast-travel/discovery state.

artifacts: plugin only if reference state needed
preemptive_questions: World map compass or local map?
patterns.notes: Config-only marker changes may have no xEdit conflict.

intent: replace player death with bleedout defeat rescue respawn injury or limited lives

conditions: One system must own the lethal/death transition.
Explicitly define killmove/execution/DoT handling and recovery cleanup.

patterns.notes: Resurrecting an actor/player state does not undo quest death side effects.

intent: change first third person camera offsets FOV transitions mount camera or camera behavior

avoid_by_default: hard-coded flat-screen camera IDs in VR-compatible code
conditions: Use semantic camera state helpers when possible.
Branch flat vs VR state IDs explicitly.

preemptive_questions: Should other camera frameworks integrate or be incompatible?

negative_tests: another camera mod owns same hook/state

patterns.notes: Flat ThirdPerson ID and VR ThirdPerson ID differ.

intent: add VR hand grabbing physical melee body interaction holsters gestures or haptics

conditions: Separate VRIK body/IK, HIGGS hand/object interaction and PLANCK actor physics.
Use VR-specific runtime/API and skeleton node validation.

preemptive_questions: Which physical layer owns the feature?
patterns.notes: VR is a distinct interaction architecture, not just another resolution.

intent: automatically patch meshes for parallax complex materials or PBR based on installed textures

conditions: Treat output as generated from exact mesh/texture winners.
Require dedicated owned output directory and regenerate on asset priority changes.

preemptive_questions: Vanilla parallax Complex Material or PBR?

runtime_tests: objects with no eligible maps stay valid

patterns.notes: PGPatcher output is never canonical source.

intent: distribute body skin height morph presets or synthesized NPC appearance at scale

avoid_by_default: mixing face replacer synthesis and body distribution without clear ownership
conditions: Assign face/head and body/morph responsibilities explicitly.
Preserve deterministic assignment state across reruns when desired.

preemptive_questions: Face replacers too, or body only?
patterns.notes: Do not let an appearance generator overwrite quest/gameplay NPC fields.
